import json, sys
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, ".claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/tools")
import edition
own = Path(sys.argv[1])
profile = edition.load(Path(".claude/skills/ld-s10y-lesson/profiles/modern-us-neutral.json"))
forbidden = profile["forbidden_terms"] + profile["forbidden_person_names"]
errors, checked = [], []
for locale, index in [("zh", 0), ("en", 0), ("en", 9)]:
    block = edition.load(own / locale / "lesson.template.json")["prose"][index]
    local = edition.validate_text(block["source_text"], block["text"],
        block["changes"], block["numeric_changes"], locale + ".prose[" + str(index) + "]",
        forbidden, block.get("historical_entities"))
    errors.extend(local)
    checked.append({"locale":locale, "index":index,
        "source_math":edition.math_signature(block["source_text"]),
        "current_math":edition.math_signature(block["text"]),
        "source_numbers":edition.prose_number_signature(block["source_text"])[0],
        "current_numbers":edition.prose_number_signature(block["text"])[0],
        "errors":local})
print(json.dumps({"status":"PASS" if not errors else "HOLD",
    "checked":checked, "errors":errors}, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2))
sys.exit(0 if not errors else 1)
